pkgmetadata.longdescription: The JavaScript parser of the Rollup bundler (Rust, based on SWC), built from source as a native Node.js addon. Installed per Rollup version as /usr/lib/rollup-native/VERSION/rollup.native.node. Used by www-client/chromium instead of the prebuilt WebAssembly parser in the @rollup/wasm-node npm package it bundles.
